hero.purpose: One-per-page landing headline in Barlow Condensed, fluid and tightly tracked.

display.purpose: Section and step titles in Barlow Condensed, usually uppercase.

body.purpose: Barlow Condensed for prose, descriptions, layer names, empty states, and recovery copy.

control.purpose: Space Mono for buttons, tabs, commands, node labels, field labels, and short values.

label.purpose: Space Mono for compact uppercase labels with moderate tracking.

meta.purpose: Space Mono for identifiers, counters, timestamps, and compact status.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Menus, popovers, dialogs, and other floating surfaces.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Warm flare action with a compact Space Mono label, visible focus, and a 44px minimum target.
components.css: background: var(--accent-primary); color: var(--surface-app); min-height: var(--control-h-default); border-radius: var(--control-radius);

components.name: Field and Input
components.description: Readable field structure with mono label grammar, explicit help or error text, and shared control states.
components.css: font-family: var(--font-body); min-height: var(--control-h-default); border: 1px solid var(--line-default);

components.name: Popover
components.description: A warm tonal floating surface using functional overlay elevation and keyboard-safe focus behavior.
components.css: background: var(--surface-panel-raised); border: 1px solid var(--line-default); box-shadow: var(--shadow-overlay);

components.name: Layer Row
components.description: A sortable row whose category rail and selected state retain the layer category color instead of the global accent.
components.css: min-height: var(--row-h-compact); color: var(--text-primary); border-color: var(--layer-category-color);

components.name: Node Housing
components.description: A readable graph card with category-colored rail, icon, handles, selection border, focus outline, and active states.

components.name: Preview Frame
components.description: Artwork frame with crisp registration marks; checkerboard remains UI chrome and never enters export output.

narrative.overview: The interface has the material feel of a print proof: mono labels, square edges, warm dark surfaces, and raw rules. It is a mixing-board chassis for shaping artwork with intent, while remaining clear, keyboardable, accessible, and explicit about state.
keyCharacteristics: Warm-tinted dark neutrals; never pure black or pure white.
One rare brand accent used like a printer registration mark.
Node category colors carry structure and remain visible in selection and focus states.
Readable condensed sans for prose; mono for controls, labels, identifiers, and short values.
Crisp artwork frames with low-radius controls and overlays where affordance requires it.
Mobile-first interaction with 44px minimum touch targets.

rules.name: The Registration-Mark Rule
rules.body: The flare accent is rare, deliberate, and load-bearing rather than a brand wash.

rules.name: The Category-Is-Grammar Rule
rules.body: Category color identifies node structure and must survive hover, selection, and focus.

rules.name: The Mono-As-Control Rule
rules.body: Use mono for commands, labels, ids, metadata, and short values; use readable sans for prose and recovery copy.

rules.name: The Layered-Tonal Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces use tonal layers and hairline rules; functional shadows are reserved for overlays, drag states, focus support, and selected graph objects.

rules.name: The Print-Mark Rule
rules.body: Frame artwork with crop or registration marks when the interface needs a print-proof signature.

dos: Keep the brand accent rare and intentional.
Use node category colors as structural grammar.
Use Barlow Condensed for readable UI copy and Space Mono for control grammar.
Keep every interactive target at least 44px on touch surfaces.
Use explicit focus, error, loading, and disabled states.
donts: Do not use pure black, pure white, generic tech blue, or creator purple as the product identity.
Do not force mono onto paragraphs, onboarding text, or dense inspector copy.
Do not replace a selected node category color with the global flare accent.
Do not add soft generic card shadows to resting surfaces.
Do not put checkerboards, crop marks, or other UI chrome into exported artwork.
